reason: Persisted service logs, abuse counters and voluntary support mail are separate from on-device favorites and viewing history.

Sender and reply address for voluntary support mail
Information voluntarily sent to resolve a support or privacy request
IP-derived country, region and city in service logs; country also chooses region-available listening links

items.classificationBasis: Conservative proposed disclosure against Apple's three-or-more-decimal-place resolution definition. This does not establish actual location accuracy or device GPS use.

items.scope: Requested work/resource identifiers in URLs and request times can reveal content access; no local favorite/history list or actual third-party playback record is uploaded
Request CPU time and elapsed time in invocation logs for service diagnostics
Network source/IP, User-Agent, request status/errors and minute-scoped abuse counters used for troubleshooting, security and service availability

classificationNotes: The data-type strings are reviewer-readable labels, not a submitted App Store Connect API payload.

Four decimal places describe the sample's stored representation, not verified physical accuracy. Confirm the final location selections against this scope.
No advertising, marketing, analytics or cross-app tracking purpose has been added. Existing website analytics are outside this native platform edition's requests.
